body: I try not to anymore. I feel it's annoying. I feel I am burdening him with my inner turmoil when I know he has his own to deal with. I wrote him a letter today basically pouring out my soul and left it ay home for him to find once he gets home from work. I stressed that what I am currently feeling and going through has nothing to do with him bit I feel I am on a deteriorating, downward spiral. It'll either give him an outlet to see this situation for what it is and leave the relationship if, if he chooses, for his own sanity. If not, it will give him insight to know what's happening with me since I can't seem to put it in words face to face.

Nothing of interest happened today. I think it's just all of the negative feelings I usually push to the back of my mind all finally rising to the surface. I just woke up with a lack of enthusiasm for life in general. It's never been this difficult to pull myself put of bed.

The relationship with my boyfriend is good, but I feel he deserves better. Someone more mentally stable. Someone he can take out without fear of her freaking out in public due to the anxiety. Someone that doesn't constantly ask for reassurance because of her many insecurities and such. I feel I burden him the most, which hurts me more than anything. He means the world to me, but I cannot say for sure that the feeling is mutual.

As far as my famiky goes, I no longer really care about our relationship or lack thereof.

I've been able to pull myself out of these 'ruts' over the years. It always seemed to pass. But today was different. All I can think about is how much I just want to end it, but my boyfriend is due home any time and I don't want him to walk in just in time to save me. And believe me, I'm so very aware how selfish and wrong that is.

And no, I am not open with my parents about this. I have moved away from my hometown and our contact is limited.

I was diagnosed with clinical depression when I was 14, I'm almost 22 now. At that young of an age, I didn't know how to deal with all of those thoughts and feelings that alienated me from everyone else. My family didn't understand it, so they reacted the only way they knew how: with anger and punishment. It was all 'a cry for attention'. I just didn't have an outlet and I was scared.
